title: Threaded Outcomes Journal — 2-week scratchpad
content:
Purpose:
Quick, low-friction notebook to stitch small experiments to metrics over a two-week cycle. Use this to track half-mile goals (30–90 minute actions) that should move the needle on a single metric by the end of the window. Not a polished plan — a place to collect threads, signals, and decisions.

How I will use this:
- Capture one primary metric per cycle (traffic, replies, feature-eng, PR throughput)
- Attach 3 micro-experiments (hypothesis, signal, short test)
- End with a 30-min retro and 3 clear next-actions

Cycle: 2026-02-16 → 2026-03-01 (two weeks)
Primary metric (hypothesis):
- Weekly active routes instrumented in the console (increase from 12 → 16 by end). Why: more routes = better sampling for intelligent routing suggestions.

Signals to watch (leading):
- Number of new routes created (weekly)
- Time-to-first-request after onboarding (median, hours)
- Conversations with two platform customers mentioning routing confusion (qualitative)

Micro-experiments (bench scratch):
1) Onboarding nudge: Add a 45-second checklist in console (copy draft below). Hypothesis: checklist reduces time-to-first-request by 25% for new projects. Signal: median time-to-first-request. Test: A/B to 20 new orgs. Links: PR-278
2) Route templates: Ship 3 example route templates for common ML patterns (chat-with-cache, short-seq-batcher, rerank). Hypothesis: templates increase new-route creation rate. Signal: template use ratio. Owner: Marcus.
3) Analytics note: Add a single event for "route_template_applied" and map to onboarding cohort. Hypothesis: event will explain variance in route creation.

Draft checklist content (console nudge):
- Step 1: Pick a route type (chat | embeddings | rerank)
- Step 2: Choose sample model + set max_tokens to 512
- Step 3: Toggle KV cache? (yes recommended for chat)
- Step 4: Click "Send test request"
- Step 5: Review token costs and set a budget

Mid-cycle notes (2/23):
- Created checklist copy; UX tee-up with Marcus is scheduled 2/24.
- Shipped route templates branch (PR-278) but instrumentation is missing. Need event.
- Talked to CS about two customers confused by region fallback; add as qualitative signal.

Retro bullets (end of cycle):
- What moved: Templates launched increased new-route creation from 0.6 → 1.1 per new project (early signal).
- What didn't: Onboarding nudge roll-out stalled; A/B not yet started due to missing analytics.
- Surprises: Region fallback confusion surfaced again, higher than expected.

Decisions & next actions:
1) Prioritize adding "route_template_applied" event (owner: me) — estimate 1 day. (Linked: CON-4512)
2) Run A/B for onboarding checklist next week once event fires.
3) Create short CS playbook for region fallback questions; share with two pilot customers. (Owner: Noor)

Loose thoughts & unresolved: 
- If new-route creation is a noisy metric, consider switching primary metric to "routes with active traffic" instead.
- Need a small deck (3 slides) showing experiment plan for CS and PM alignment.

Quick to-dos (this file is my single source scratch):
- [ ] Implement event mapping (route_template_applied) — high priority
- [ ] Add checklist A/B config to console (feature flag)
- [ ] Draft 3-slide experiment summary and share to #product-experiments
- [ ] Schedule 30-min retro (calendar invite)

Notes to self: Keep threads short — experiment, observe, decide within 2 weeks. Track qualitative customer quotes inline under Signals. If something drifts beyond two cycles, escalate to a roadmap ticket.
